verdict.rationale: Veo 3's own docs briefly claim "extended videos" as one of its creative controls, and the Gemini API docs describe multi-turn refinement and conversational editing such as element replacement. That gives a thin first-party basis for extending clips. Nothing shows a creator can regenerate a single time segment while leaving the rest of the clip untouched. missing for 10: documented clip-extension workflow details (how extension works, length limits, continuity), explicit segment-level regeneration without re-rendering the whole video, hands-on or independent corroboration of either capability.
